clips.title: The story
paras: Across the central and southern Barrens, hunters claim Thunderhawk Wings from the wind serpents that soar overhead. At Camp Taurajo, Jorn Skyseer receives them as proof of a hunter’s strength, cunning, and endurance.

Hunters stationed at Camp Taurajo prize a pair of intact Thunderhawk Wings. Wind serpents, whom local hunters call thunderhawks, are fierce winged reptiles that strike swiftly from above. Tracking them across the open plains and claiming their wings in combat tests a hunter’s skill. For an initiate, bringing back the wings proves readiness to follow the lifelong path of an accomplished hunter.
